offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures noninvasive patient monitoring devices, sensors and software sold to hospitals, surgical centers and consumers, with monitors and sensors sold to clinical buyers and wearables sold directly and through retail.

primary_products.value: pulse oximetry sensors; patient monitors; noninvasive hemoglobin monitoring devices; wearable health monitors; hospital connectivity software

primary_services.value: technical support and maintenance; clinical software and data integration

customer_segment.value: B2B: hospitals, surgical centers, emergency medical services, clinical providers; B2C: consumers buying wearable health and fitness monitors

revenue_model.value: product sales: monitors, sensors and wearable devices sold to hospitals and consumers; subscription: software licenses and subscriptions for hospital connectivity and monitoring; service fees: maintenance, support and service contracts for installed devices

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: designs and builds monitors and sensors, sold to hospitals and distributors; brand owner: markets its own medical and wearable devices under its brands; software / platform: hospital software platforms that connect and manage patient monitoring devices
value_chain_position.category: OEM / manufacturer; brand owner; software / platform

geography_served.value: global: sales in the United States and many international markets through direct and partner channels

specialization.value: related lines: patient monitoring devices, sensors, connectivity software and wearable health monitors

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: direct sales teams selling to hospitals and health systems; distributors / dealers: distributors serving hospitals and clinics in various regions; online: online store selling consumer wearable health devices; partners / resellers: medical equipment partners and resellers in international markets
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; distributors / dealers; online; partners / resellers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: medical devices needing FDA clearance and international medical device approvals

notes: Masimo agreed to sell its Sound United audio businesses, which I have excluded; the sale status and the consumer wearable details may have changed.
